title: Tab close has a real hit target; phone messages to a closed Assistant start it instead of being lost

requirements.text: The close x on a session tab has a hit target of at least 18x18 pt
A phone message sent while the Assistant is closed is queued, acked, and the Mac app starts the Assistant with it
If the Mac app is not running, the bridge launches it in the background when a message is queued
On the phone, a message that fails to send stays visible and can be retried; the draft is not cleared when not connected
requirements.check: manual: phone build compiles; failed bubble shows Retry

evidence: SessionsView.swift TabCloseButton: glyph in .frame(width:18,height:18) + contentShape(Rectangle()) + hover circle; negative padding keeps tab size; swift build -> Build complete

npm test in mobile/bridge -> 16 pass 0 fail, incl. queue.test.mjs: closed Assistant -> tell in phone/inbox, queued:true, wake called; bridge acks {queued:true} and sends assistant:'starting'. Mac AppModel.takePhoneInbox starts Assistant with the inbox as openingMessage (compiled; not yet exercised live, app restart pending)
lib.mjs wakeApp: pgrep -x Genlock exit 1 -> open -g -b com.locklainn.genlock; queue test asserts wake called once when closed, zero when open
